==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have a magical, glittering, colorful PDA device with a stylus. I use it to operate as a masked hero. I even have my own sidekick.
My sidekick and I are pestered by reporters. The news is obsessed with discovering our true identities. I don't want the world to know who I am under the mask.
My hero identity is loved by the people. I feel as if only a few friends really care about my civilian identity. While tempting, I refuse to give up my civilian life.
